Callvale (STARTUP.md, chapter 19, stage 3, month 20): 14 engineers release one application together, one release takes 40 minutes; the application runs on an Auto Scaling group that the team must patch. Decision: Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate, six services (dashboard, upload, search, accounts, billing, admin) behind the Application Load Balancer; adds Amazon ECR, service auto scaling and task roles. Accepts less control of the host and a higher price for each unit of compute. Rejected: six Auto Scaling groups; Amazon EKS (one engineer knows Kubernetes). Fargate minimum 3 tasks per service, 1 per service in the standby Region later. Ben asks: 'ECS or EKS? My one Kubernetes engineer says that EKS is the standard.' Demand items tagged 'callvale' hold the facts behind that answer. Question stems never name Callvale.
